```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
history <- read_parquet("data/history.parquet")
groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(outcome_numeric = case_when(
    outcome == "YES" ~ 1,
    outcome == "NO" ~ 0,
    .default = NA_real_
  )) |>
  mutate(days_until_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(resolved_at) - date)) |>
  mutate(time_bucket = factor(
    case_when(
      days_until_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
      between(days_until_resolution, 31, 90) ~ "30 to 90 days",
      between(days_until_resolution, 8, 30) ~ "7 to 30 days",
      between(days_until_resolution, 1, 7) ~ "1 to 7 days",
      days_until_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "More than 90 days",
      "30 to 90 days",
      "7 to 30 days",
      "1 to 7 days",
      "Final day"
    ),
    ordered = TRUE
  )) |>
  mutate(absolute_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric))
```

`market_groups` links markets to topic slugs: a market can have multiple rows. `groups` is a lookup table keyed by `group_slug`, adding each topic's name, broad category, and market count.

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket) |>
  summarise(
    mean_absolute_error = mean(absolute_error),
    snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(accuracy)

accuracy |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_absolute_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Time until resolution",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```

```{r}
joined |>
  filter(days_until_resolution == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0) +
  labs(
    x = "Forecast probability",
    y = "Number of snapshots"
  )
```

```{r}
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_until_resolution == 0) |>
  mutate(probability_bin = cut(
    probability,
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
    labels = paste0(seq(0, 90, by = 10), "-", seq(10, 100, by = 10), "%"),
    include.lowest = TRUE
  )) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    predicted_probability = mean(probability),
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n_distinct(market_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(calibration)

calibration |>
  ggplot(aes(x = predicted_probability, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Do final-day predictions match observed outcomes?",
    x = "Mean predicted probability",
    y = "Actual YES rate",
    size = "Markets"
  )
```
